card.name: The digit 1 starting section 14 references
card.fires_on: The digit "1" that begins the number 14 inside a bracketed cross-reference to Clinical Studies, as in "Clinical Studies (14.2)". It is weaker on a few ordinary words in research-consent text.

modes.label: Clinical Studies section number
modes.description: The first digit of 14, written as 1 then 4, in a bracketed cross-reference to Clinical Studies.

modes.label: Research consent wording
modes.description: Ordinary words like is or in in text about child assent and waivers in research.
